notes.title: February Love Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🤍LOVE IS IN THE AIR🤍[/h1]
[h3](for a limited time)[/h3]
[h2]Get cosy[/h2]
Our February update comes with some beautiful changes to the Zoo. 
The Karma hearts will be red and if you take a closer look around, you'll see all kinds of pretty decor.
It's the time of [b]love and cooperation[/b]. New Blobs are especially welcome to try out the game and teams with newcomers will profit even more than before!
On top of that we added KarmaZoo community items to Steam as well so now you can collect cards, decor your profile with backgrounds and show your love with cute emotes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/49b0bc1825dfa22b6cf0e6de4708f42b4db93ae6.gif[/img]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list][*]🐌 Introducing the [b]Snail Sherpa![/b]
[*]💗[b] Beginner Blobs[/b] will now (and forever) give [b]5[/b] instead of [b]2[/b] Karma to others
[*]💋 [b] Karma Kiss [/b]gives[b] 2[/b] Karma instead of [b]1[/b] during the event
[*]⭐ +X% bonus on Karma when reaching the Karma Tree with a smaller number of people.
[b]Perfect for a romantic Zoo date[/b] of 2 or 3 or more...
(X goes from 50% when there is only 2 players down to 0% when the game is full)[/list][h1]SNAIL SHERPA[/h1]
[list][*][b]Time Freeze[/b] Slows down time ⏱️
[*][b]Karma Boost[/b] Boosts targeted characters by decreasing the Karma Kiss cooldown 💋
[*][b]Karma Zone[/b] Creates a zone in which each Karma Heart that goes through will be doubled 🤍🤍[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/c08b52f70ffe117b400f5137e37338dd24be6fd8.gif[/img]
[h1]COMMUNITY ITEMS[/h1]
We added emotes, backgrounds, cards and cool badges for you to collect!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/a376d034515509f026d72d6db32acf49440680c0.png[/img]
[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[i]v.1.05.010 --> v.1.06.002 [/i]

[b]GENERAL[/b]
St Valentine's & Lunar New Year Event
[list][*]Love is in the air! KarmaZoo's blossoms into the month of celebrating love. Enjoy the skin of love and lights while it lasts!
[*]Karma Kisses are juicier so share with your teammates at will!
[*]All 2 player games see their score boosted! Share good times with your partner.
[*]Unlock the exclusive Snail Sherpa with its love boosting ability and time controlling powers!
[/list][b]LOOP[/b]
[i]Fixed[/i]
[list][*]Clover bonus cards only appear when a Clover is in the group
[*]Accessibility: Background Density now shows Peacock Sherpa Feedback correctly
[*]Overall code stability to prevent multiple crashes 
[*]Minor bugfixes including Karma scoring and saving
[/list][i]Improved[/i]
[list][*]Newcomers give more Karma Hearts (up to 5) when helped by other players
[*]Bonus Perks effects' feedback and balancing
[/list]
If you need more information, want to chat to others of our super wholesome and active community, 
click the banner to join our Discord! 

[url=www.discord.gg/KarmaZoo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/720d603b0ae520825e7dbd87cb4ad34cba6cb22f.png[/img][/url]

xoxo Pastagames

notes.title: KarmaZoo Patch 1 Hotfix 1 is Live
notes.notes:
[h1]KarmaZoo Patch 1 Hotfix 1[/h1]

We work hard to further improve the game and appreciate your feedback!
Here's the list of changes from last time.

[i]version number: 1.05.019[/i]
[h2]This hotfix patch brings a fix for 3 major issues:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Wolf, Turtle, Flower Pot and Elephant tombstones missions could not be completed
[*] Some players were getting disconnected from certain game sessions because they stayed on the "Voting Perk" screen for more than 30 seconds. The timeout has been increased to 50 seconds
[*] PS5 / Xbox only: Music was never resumed after triggering a Naughty Eye
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/63511e5f2f7d0908a6d54ea43eafbb9d8d3361c8.png[/img]

notes.title: Improvements & Patch notes 🔔
notes.notes:
[h1]KarmaZoo Patch 1[/h1]

It's been a wild ride so far and we were busy reading your feedback, fixing bugs and improving the game as much as we can. This couldn't be possible without your help!

Below you'll see a list of [b]patch notes![/b]
We hope you continue to enjoy the game and earn more Karma together.
Thank you so much for anyone leaving a positive review as well, it really helps us a lot! 
[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[i]version number: 1.05.015[/i]

These patch notes contain the major changes made since the game release on November 14, 2023, [i]version 1.04.010[/i]
[h2]Many bugs, exploits and some crashes fixed[/h2]
[list][*]related to characters' abilities and missions
[*]related to the bonus cards
[*]related to the Sanctuary
[*]related to streaming options
[*]disconnections not handled properly every time
[*]stronger anti-cheat system
[*]level design (cameras, respawn positions, blockers, ...)
[*]texts display from other alphabets than the selected one
[*]tutorial robot behavior
[/list][h2]Better Balance[/h2]
[list][*]some telescope missions' difficulty
[*]some exploits that were generating too much Karma for the party

[/list] Overall, the game is now more stable and has no more known major issues or exploits remaining.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/63511e5f2f7d0908a6d54ea43eafbb9d8d3361c8.png[/img]

For more detailed Patch notes or If you need more information, want to chat to others of our super wholesome and active community, join our Discord! There's giveaways, 
game lore and a lot of other players. 

[url=www.discord.gg/KarmaZoo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/720d603b0ae520825e7dbd87cb4ad34cba6cb22f.png[/img][/url]
